🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive — Internal Rotation. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Tech in Top 5); mixed megacap signals and sector-level rotation confirm the neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Industrials lead: CAT (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +24.84%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong pockets: NEM (1W: +13.91% | 1M: -3.58%) RECOVERY. Financials supportive: COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy clearly lagging: XOM (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -6.44% | 1M: -8.62%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -5.39%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples/Real Estate show weakness or flatness amid rotation.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +16.15%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +13.91% | 1M: -3.58%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: +13.28% | 1M: +21.73%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Tech) — style mixed, no clear single-factor leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MPC (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -5.39%) BELOW TREND, OXY (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -10.75%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -7.26% | 1M: -10.70%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -8.50% | 1M: -12.13%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and selected Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +16.15%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence across megacaps (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL showing short-term bounces while MSFT, META, AMZN remain BELOW TREND) — treat moves as tactical until confirmed.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with rotation and dispersion: AAPL (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +2.11% | 1M: -7.84%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +2.08% | 1M: -8.30%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%) BELOW TREND. Technology breadth mixed; watch for whether semiconductor strength broadens beyond equipment names.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and leading on the week: JPM (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.30% | 1M: -0.68%) RECOVERY. Financials show consistent rotation into cyclicals and credit-sensitive names — breadth supportive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Short-term softening against a stronger 1M: JNJ (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +2.89%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.39% | 1M: +2.73%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -2.14% | 1M: +12.54%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND. Sector showing profit-taking after 1M strength — watch drug approvals/news for directional cues.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Industrials and Financials (CAT, GE, JPM) while reducing exposure to lagging Energy and pressured high-multiple Tech (ADBE, ORCL, NOW). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; use selectivity and monitor megacap divergences for confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -1.65%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +5.82%) and Financials (1W: +3.74%) — watch leadership breadth. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -6.45%) and Communication/Consumer Discretionary dispersion — monitor earnings/news catalysts.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch AMAT/LRCX follow-through above this week’s breakout to confirm secular thrust: AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%) ABOVE TREND. Monitor AAPL support as RECOVERY hold: AAPL (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY, and JPM momentum continuation above recent highs: JPM (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (+60): Microsoft (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND — positive AI-China headlines but price is diverging (news > price), watch for follow-through. AAPL (+55): Apple (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with short-term bounce. VST (+60): Vistra (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +16.15%) ABOVE TREND — bullish headline confirming price strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-45): Oracle (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -1.65%) BELOW TREND — negative coverage confirming the sell-off. ADBE (-45): Adobe (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%) BELOW TREND — downgrade and price collapse are aligned, elevated downside risk.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMAT ABOVE TREND, LRCX ABOVE TREND, JPM ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among megacaps (MSFT BELOW TREND vs AAPL/NVDA RECOVERY) and concentrated tech leadership warrant monitoring before expanding directional exposure.
